SERVER.DESCRIPTION: Manage game servers of this guild
SERVER.SUB_MOVE: Move server to another root server
SERVER.OPT_TARGET_ROOTSERVER: Target root server (where the server will be moved)
SERVER.OPT_ROOTSERVER: Rootserver (where the gameserver will be created)
SERVER.OPT_RAM: RAM limit in MB (empty = no limit)
SERVER.OPT_DISK: Disk limit in GB (empty = no limit)
SERVER.OPT_FILTER_ROOTSERVER: Only servers of a specific rootserver
SERVER.CREATE_HINT: Once the daemon finishes installation, start it with `/server start`.
SERVER.SUB_PANEL_ADD: Create a Discord status panel for a gameserver
SERVER.SUB_PANEL_LIST: List the status panels of this guild
SERVER.OPT_PANEL_CHANNEL: Channel the panel should live in
SERVER.OPT_PANEL_CONTROLS: Buttons to start and stop (default: yes)
SERVER.SUB_PANEL_EDIT: Change the settings of a status panel
